component.name: ActOne
component.summary: Modern screenplay and script writing application

description.p: ActOne Screenplay is the native plain-text Fountain screenplay editor for Windows and Linux. Featuring live syntax formatting, outline tree navigation, X-Ray analytics, automatic revision snapshots, and local Muse AI assistant.
ActOne supports standard Fountain markup, index cards, customizable visual themes, ambient focus soundscapes, and production-ready PDF & FDX exports.
